name: io.github.tonyyang0504/kuaishou-mcp
description: Kuaishou (social): me, delete, analytics_post. Every tool maps to a documented endpoint.

environmentVariables.name: PLATFORM_MCP_KUAISHOU_APP_ID
environmentVariables.description: app_id of your Kuaishou Open Platform application (https://open.kuaishou.com/platform).

environmentVariables.name: PLATFORM_MCP_KUAISHOU_APP_SECRET
environmentVariables.description: app_secret of the same application; sent only to /oauth2/refresh_token.

environmentVariables.name: PLATFORM_MCP_KUAISHOU_REFRESH_TOKEN
environmentVariables.description: The user's refresh_token from the 快手登录 authorization-code exchange (/oauth2/access_token, scopes user_info, user_video_info, user_video_delete; valid 180 days). It is single-use: every refresh returns a new one that replaces it (persisted when PLATFORM_MCP_STATE_DIR is set; 'refreshToken.discarded' means an old one was reused).
